project.name: SkillWeave Initiative 06 — GitHub Action, GitHub App, and Integration Layer
project.description: GitHub-native validation and release readiness Actions, trust signal generation, and GitHub App feasibility assessment

objectives.description: Create a Bundle Validation GitHub Action that validates SkillWeave bundle structure and metadata
Create a Release Readiness GitHub Action that checks release prerequisites
Assess GitHub App feasibility and document recommendation

tasks.title: Define Action specifications and output format
tasks.description: Specify validation checks, release readiness checks, input parameters, and standardized JSON/Markdown output format for both Actions.
acceptance_criteria: Validation checks list defined (structure, metadata, manifest, docs)
Release readiness checks list defined (version, changelog, tests, files)
Input parameters specified for both Actions
Output format defined: JSON with checks[], summary, pass/fail counts
GitHub annotations format defined (error/warning)

tasks.title: Set up skillweave-action-validate repository
tasks.description: Create separate repository for Bundle Validation Action with action.yml, src/, dist/, README, and CI workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Repository structure: action.yml, src/, dist/, README.md
action.yml has inputs: path, strictness
README has usage examples
CI workflow validates the Action itself
Semantic versioning configured

tasks.title: Implement bundle validation logic
tasks.description: Core validation: skill directory structure, SKILL.md presence, capability.yaml schema, required fields, manifest consistency, no broken internal references.
acceptance_criteria: Validates skill directory structure
Checks SKILL.md presence per skill
Validates capability.yaml against schema
Checks required fields in skill metadata
Detects broken internal references
Produces structured JSON output with per-check results
Configurable strictness (lenient, standard, strict)

tasks.title: Set up skillweave-action-release-check repository
tasks.description: Create separate repository for Release Readiness Action with action.yml, src/, dist/, README, and CI workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Repository structure: action.yml, src/, dist/, README.md
action.yml has inputs: require_changelog, require_version_bump, require_tests
README has usage examples
CI workflow validates the Action itself
Semantic versioning configured

tasks.title: Implement release readiness check logic
tasks.description: Check version bump, CHANGELOG updated, tests passing, required files present, no WIP markers. Produce readiness report.
acceptance_criteria: Checks version bump (compares to previous release)
Checks CHANGELOG has entry for new version
Checks test suite exists and passes
Checks required files present (configurable list)
Detects WIP/draft markers in release candidate
Produces readiness report (JSON + Markdown)
Can block PR merge as status check

tasks.title: Implement trust signal generation
tasks.description: Generate validation badge for README, store validation results as release assets, create attestation-ready output format.
acceptance_criteria: Validation badge generatable (shields.io compatible)
Validation results stored as GitHub release asset
Validation history trackable across releases
Output format supports future supply chain signing
Badge URL documented in README

tasks.title: GitHub App feasibility assessment
tasks.description: Assess whether a GitHub App adds value beyond Actions. Evaluate: repo sync, release signal capture, trust enrichment, discovery support. Recommend proceed/defer/skip.
acceptance_criteria: Assessment covers 4 use cases: repo sync, release signals, trust, discovery
Build cost and maintenance burden evaluated
User value assessed per use case
Clear recommendation: proceed / defer / skip with rationale
If proceed: MVP scope defined
Assessment saved to .skillweave/prds/initiative-06/github-app-assessment.md

tasks.title: Test Actions on SkillWeave repository
tasks.description: Run both Actions against the SkillWeave repo. Validate output format, check accuracy, verify no false positives.
acceptance_criteria: Validation Action runs on SkillWeave repo without errors
Release Readiness Action runs and produces correct assessment
No false positives on known-good structure
False negatives detected on intentionally broken structure
Output JSON validates against defined schema
Markdown output is human-readable

tasks.title: Prepare Actions for distribution
tasks.description: Version tag both Actions, prepare for GitHub Marketplace (or direct reference), document version pinning.
acceptance_criteria: Both Actions tagged with v1.0.0
Major version tag (v1) created for version pinning
dist/ folder built and committed
Marketplace listing prepared (or direct-reference README)
Usage examples in both READMEs

assumptions.description: SkillWeave bundle structure is stable enough to validate
assumptions.validation_method: Review structure stability across last 3 releases

assumptions.description: Separate repos for Actions is the right architectural choice

technical: Actions must work on ubuntu-latest GitHub runners
Core SkillWeave repo has no Action-related code

risks.description: Actions too rigid for diverse bundle structures
risks.mitigation: Configurable strictness levels, extensible check system
Minimal scope, automated testing, shared CI patterns

risks.description: False positives in validation erode trust
risks.mitigation: Conservative defaults, whitelist mechanism, thorough testing

execution_recommendation.reason: 9 tasks, ~8 hours total, moderate dependencies, involves separate repos
